effects: Each combat equipment item counts as 2 additional pieces towards its set effect.
body.name: Chaotic Insight

assumptions: Each qualifying equipped item contributes its intrinsic set weight plus 2 additional effective pieces.
Intrinsic weighted items such as the Visage remain additive; Chaotic Insight does not multiply their intrinsic weight.
First Necromancer damage and duration caps remain 5 effective pieces.

reason: Represent Chaotic Insight as additive effective pieces per equipped item.
